steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors, corresponding to Vendor A and Vendor B in the case.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list.
Verify that exactly two vendors are participants and nobody else is listed.
